## [1.6.0](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/compare/v1.5.0...v1.6.0) (2026-10-22)

### ✨ New Features

* Vimu credits auto/button/off and preview support ([92509e8](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/92509e8d63f483c45997a6fbdad2d1874da409c2))
* Vimu credits auto/button/off and preview support ([a610113](https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches/commit/a610113b0f90c693e069afa190351586dafc1532))

patches.name: Auto-pick best stream
patches.description: Skips the stream list and plays the top ranked stream. Enable Always show stream list to see every stream.

patches.name: Avoid SDH subtitles
patches.description:
Prefers full dialogue subtitles over SDH/CC tracks and strips sound notes when none remain.

Avoid SDH v1.0.0
Repository: https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches

patches.name: Binge with external players
patches.description: Auto-plays the next episode in the same external player when an episode finishes in Vimu, MX Player, VLC or mpv.

patches.name: External player progress
patches.description: Saves watch progress in Stremio when playing in an external player, and starts the player at the saved position.

patches.name: External player progress manifest
patches.description: Declares the keep-alive service for External player progress. Runs with that patch.

patches.name: Hide spoilers
patches.description:
Hides thumbnails and synopses for unwatched episodes in Stremio.

Hide spoilers v1.0.0
Repository: https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches

patches.name: Intro Skip
patches.description:
Adds intro and recap skip controls for TV shows, movies and anime in Stremio.

Intro Skip v1.0.0
Repository: https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches

options.description: Opens the Intro Skip log when playback starts, to check the title, season, episode and API calls.

patches.name: Remember tracks per show
patches.description: Remembers the last audio and subtitle choice for each series and applies it to other episodes.

patches.name: External player result (Vimu)
patches.description: Returns position and duration from Vimu so Stremio saves progress. Runs with the Intro Skip (Vimu) patch.

patches.name: Intro Skip (Vimu)
patches.description:
Adds intro and recap skip for TV shows, movies and anime in Vimu.

Intro Skip v1.0.0
Repository: https://github.com/tikkamasalla/stremio-morphe-patches

patches.name: Intro Skip native fix (Vimu)
patches.description: Fixes native crashes on rapid seeks in the Vimu media engine. Runs with the Intro Skip (Vimu) patch.

patches.name: Intro Skip settings row (Vimu)
patches.description: Adds the Intro Skip settings to Vimu Settings. Runs with the Intro Skip (Vimu) patch.
